P7609.corridor_notes: 威海高压天然气管线一期工程：以国家管网集团泰青威管道威海分输站为起点，途经临港区汪疃镇、文登区米山镇、宋村镇，至线路终点宋村分输站；规划高压天然气长输管线37公里+市政高压天然气管线9公里。截至2024年6月，地文头至汪疃分输站(3.65km)及汪疃至威海港华燃气市政段(3.25km)已建成通气，汪疃至宋村段预计年底前完成。GEM段名 'Weihai High Pressure Gas Pipeline' (Wangtong Town→Songcun) 对应汪疃至宋村段，与工程规划长输管线37km总长一致（GEM LengthMergedKm=37.00）。
P7609.researcher_notes: Qilu Network (齐鲁网, Shandong provincial state media) article gives the full corridor with all station names and exact segment lengths; the 37km trunk length matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (37.00) exactly, confirming this PID = the 汪疃至宋村 (Wangtuan-to-Songcun) leg of the larger Weihai high-pressure pipeline Phase 1 project (whose true overall corridor start is further upstream at 威海分输站/Weihai Distribution Station on the PipeChina Taiqingwei trunk line). GEM's 'Wangtong Town' appears to be a transliteration variant of 汪疃镇 (Wangtuan Town) — flagging for spelling-standardization review, not a location error. As of the June 2024 source, the Wangtuan–Songcun section itself was still targeted for year-end 2024 completion; GEM's Status_sheet='operating' implies it was completed on schedule, but no later confirming article was found this session (see blockers).
P7609.blockers: No source postdating June 2024 was found to directly confirm completion/gas-flow specifically on the Wangtuan–Songcun leg (vs. the already-confirmed Diwentou–Wangtuan leg) — endpoint identity and route are solidly confirmed, but the operating-status timing relies on GEM's own Status_sheet value rather than an independent post-completion source.
